extName.description: Extension name shown in the Chrome Web Store, the toolbar and the popup header. The product name: never translated.

extDescription.message: Permite que Kaiord App lea el plan de tu entrenador en Train2Go, tus zonas y tu peso, con tu propio inicio de sesión de Train2Go
extDescription.description: Extension description shown in the Chrome Web Store.

checking.description: Status verdict while the popup probes the connection.

checkingCause.message: Suele tardar menos de un segundo.
checkingCause.description: Status cause sentence shown while the probe runs.

connected.description: Status verdict when connected but no user name is available.

connectedAs.description: Status verdict when connected, naming the signed-in user.

coachSub.description: Status cause line naming the athlete's coach.

typePlannedSession.description: Capability chip for the Planned Session data type imported into Kaiord.

typeTrainingZones.description: Capability chip for the Training Zones data type imported into Kaiord.

typeWeight.description: Capability chip for the Weight data type imported into Kaiord.

profileStale.message: Los datos del perfil son antiguos. Abre Kaiord para traer los últimos.
profileStale.description: Athlete-card placeholder when the cached snapshot is stale.

noProfile.message: Todavía no hay perfil. Abre Kaiord para configurar FTP, ritmo y FC.
noProfile.description: Athlete-card placeholder when no snapshot exists.

noThresholds.message: El perfil todavía no tiene umbrales. Abre Kaiord para configurar FTP, ritmo y FC.
noThresholds.description: Athlete-card placeholder when the snapshot has no threshold fields.

labelSport.description: Athlete-card field label for the active sport.

labelPace.description: Athlete-card field label for threshold running pace.

labelMaxHr.description: Athlete-card field label for maximum heart rate.

labelWeight.description: Athlete-card field label for body weight.

captionThisWeek.description: Caption above the weekly rollup section.

weekPlanned.description: Label under the weekly count of planned sessions. Lower-case: it sits beneath its figure rather than starting a sentence.

weekDone.description: Label under the weekly count of completed sessions.

weekWorkload.description: Label under the weekly workload total.

rollupUnavailable.message: Resumen no disponible — inténtalo de nuevo
rollupUnavailable.description: Weekly rollup fallback when the week read fails.

coachNotes.description: Summary label of the collapsible coach-notes box.

updatedAgo.description: Athlete-card freshness line, e.g. 'Updated 10 minutes ago'.

updatedJustNow.description: Athlete-card freshness line for a very recent update.

openEditor.description: Footer link that opens the Kaiord editor.

refresh.description: Accessible label for the header refresh button.

outageSince.description: Dates an outage under the Connection notice, once an earlier popup open already recorded it. Claims only when this extension first saw the check fail.
